title: IIEST Student Wiki — IIEST Student Wiki
text:
IIEST Student Wiki

This college is old, really old. And like many older institutions, essential information is scattered and locked away in the heads of a few individuals. This wiki aims to document the current state of the institute (as of 2026) for the benefit of students and the broader community. Beyond a few outdated Facebook groups, Quora threads, and unmaintained notes, reliable information on the web is scarce -- and this wiki changes that!

title: IIEST Student Wiki — Community
text:
Community

We have maintained two vibrant and active communities since November 2025. Everyone is welcome to join the conversation on our subreddit. We also have a Discord Server, which requires a quick verification process to enter.

title: About — About
text:
About

Shibpur Wiki is a small student-run effort to keep useful IIEST Shibpur information in one place.
It is not an official institute website. It is a place for notes, links, corrections, and lived student knowledge that would otherwise stay scattered in chats.

title: Hostels — Room Types

Room Types

4 seater : currently the 1st year hostels are majorly 4 seatered, space is an issue, but fun to live if you get the right roomates.
5 Seater : In each boys hostel, "4"-5 seater room are there, the room is bigger than hte 4 seaters and has an attached balcony.
8 seater: Only in H-10, "2"-8 seater rooms are there.

title: Hostels — Halls And New Hostels
text:
Halls And New Hostels

Currently we have 5 HALLS for boys and 2 Halls for girls.
Halls for boys are - wolfenden, Richardson, MacDonalds, Sen, Sengupta
Halls for Girls are - Pandya and Lt. William.
The boys halls are generally for the 4th years, few 3rd years also stay and the college-senate position holders are also the residents of the halls.
The boys halls are generally 1 or 2 seaters.

title: Hostels — Hygiene And Cleanliness
text:
Hygiene And Cleanliness

Bathrooms are cleaned everyday.
Filter drinking water are available
Waste disposal points are there
Mess is clean.
Rooms are to be cleaned by the individuals living in them, though the staff would assist you if you ask them to.

title: Hostels — In-time
text:
In-time

for the first two months, irrespective of gender, your hostel intime is 7PM
The intime gets extended to 10PM afterwards for the rest of the year.

title: Soft Ragging And Intro — Immediate Steps
text:
Immediate Steps

Leave the situation if possible.
Preserve messages, call logs, photos, and dates.
Contact trusted seniors, faculty, hostel authorities, or anti-ragging channels.
Add official anti-ragging links here and verify them every semester.
Avoid publishing names on the wiki. This page should guide action, not run public trials.

title: Departments With No Senior Batch — Questions To Ask

Are alumni absent, or just not from the same program name?
